snippet.title: Legends of Castile demo gameplay first 10 minutes (English)
snippet.description:
This is a gameplay video of the first 10 minutes of the game demo for Legends of Castile, a point-and-click adventure game.

Join our prelaunch Kickstarter campaign, help us turn this game into a reality, and don’t miss out on the fantastic rewards we’re preparing for the campaign.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/torrezno/legends-of-castile-a-folk-point-and-click-adventure-game

You can also wishlist the game and play a game demo on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325200/Legends_of_Castile/

And for those who prefer DRM-free options, the game demo is available on Itch.io:
https://torrezno-entertainment.itch.io/legends-of-castile

Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain during the 19th century. The story follows a village girl named María, who dreams of becoming a nun. To achieve her goal, she must investigate the myths and legends of Castile, collecting evidence of their existence. The game features lateral logic puzzles, hand-drawn graphics, and a delightful blend of humor and Spanish folklore. 

You can find more information about the game on the official website:
https://www.legendsofcastile.com/
